qualitative_findings: B1/B2 static road contains extensive RGB confetti and dynamic carries road/background. V static road is markedly cleaner and the target is largely removed in fixed images.
V dynamic still contains broad road/reflection/colour fragments and background textures. Its background has not become empty.
V target remains in composite/dynamic; actor dynamic alpha is about.961 and support remains1, so the intervention is not a global dynamic collapse. Colour/edge/detail fidelity still worsens.
Fixed raw48 static retains left-edge coloured vehicle fragments and dark/blurred residuals. Crosswalk/road colour and removal remnants remain; no dense edited GT exists behind the car.

Supplement raw45 from the all49 adverse actor screen shows a softer left-edge target in V than B2; its actor mask has307 pixels. Whole composite remains clear. The quantitative target cost is retained alongside per-frame mask areas and existing pooled errors.
causal_interpretation: With the actual state, sample/time_shift/LR and evaluation controls retained, this isolated coefficient supports a background-allocation direction in this recovery window. Every observed-static MSE improves, but every full-composite and actor-composite MSE worsens against both originals. The experiment does not establish complete scene separation, geometric correctness, shadow quality, or the author formula.
statistical_limit: B1/B2 is one observed original repeat. Absolute difference of means and distribution of paired per-frame absolute differences are distinct; neither is a universal CUDA noise bound, confidence interval or significance test.
measurement_limits: Equal-frame49 is primary; pooled/pixel-weighted quantities are separately labeled.
Complete signed/absolute per-frame effects versus B1 and B2 are retained; no adverse frames discarded.
Body-mask exterior can include shadows; removal-locality is composite-versus-static change, not dense edited-GT accuracy.
Source mask recipe/count/input hashes were checked, but runtime mask pixels and actualScene pose snapshots were not saved.
The supplemental adverse frame is disclosed as post-result selection.
No coefficient, domain, support cutoff, loss or geometry threshold changed for a favourable result.
next_step_judgment: Retain V as evidence of allocation improvement with a clear composite/target tradeoff, not a finished fix. A separately approved controlled from-zero validation could test whether this recovery tradeoff persists from initialization; keep both actor fidelity and all49 residual support as required observations. Do not infer that more continuation, a coefficient change or SGCM/depth changes are justified by these data alone.
